people.name: Carlos Alberto Arroyo del Río
people.nameZh: 卡洛斯·阿羅約·德爾里奧

body.zh-Hant: 阿羅約·德爾里奧1893年11月27日生於瓜亞基爾。他研讀法律後從事私人執業，並在瓜亞基爾大學任教，同時活躍於自由激進黨，擔任慈善委員會成員。1917至1918年他任市議會秘書，1921至1922年任市議會議長。
body.en: Arroyo del Río was born in Guayaquil on 27 November 1893. After studying law he entered private practice and taught at the University of Guayaquil, and he became active in the Liberal Radical Party, serving as a member of the Junta de Beneficencia. He was secretary of the Municipal Council in 1917-1918 and its president in 1921-1922.

heading.zh-Hant: 國會、參議院與反對派領袖
heading.en: Congress, the Senate and opposition leadership

body.zh-Hant: 1922至1923年阿羅約·德爾里奧代表瓜亞斯省出任國會議員，1923年擔任眾議院議長；1924年當選參議員，反對1925年7月的革命與阿約拉政府。1932年他出任瓜亞基爾大學校長；1934至1935年他領導國會反對總統貝拉斯科·伊瓦拉，結果國會遭解散。
body.en: In 1922-1923 he represented Guayas Province in congress and in 1923 served as president of the Chamber of Deputies. Elected senator in 1924, he opposed the revolution of July 1925 and the Ayora administration. He became rector of the University of Guayaquil in 1932, and in 1934-1935 he led the congressional opposition to President Velasco Ibarra, which ended in the dissolution of congress.

body.zh-Hant: 總統阿雷利奧·莫斯克拉·納瓦埃斯在任內去世後，阿羅約·德爾里奧以參議院議長身分接掌行政權，並主持一場特別國會，廢止1938年憲法、恢復1906年憲法。
body.en: After President Aurelio Mosquera Narváez died in office, Arroyo del Río assumed executive power as president of the Senate and presided over an extraordinary congress that abrogated the Constitution of 1938 and reinstated the Constitution of 1906.

citations.quote: When Aurelio Mosquera Narváez died in office
assumed executive power as president of the Senate

abrogated the Constitution of 1938

body.zh-Hant: 他於1940年9月1日當選後就任。對手貝拉斯科·伊瓦拉的支持者指控選舉舞弊並發動政變，政變失敗，包括貝拉斯科·伊瓦拉與卡洛斯·格瓦拉·莫雷諾在內的領導人遭流放。就職數月內，秘魯入侵厄瓜多爾聲稱擁有的領土。1944年他因1941年與秘魯邊界戰爭失利而被迫下台，貝拉斯科·伊瓦拉自流亡中被召回接任。
body.en: He was elected and took office on 1 September 1940. Supporters of his leading opponent Velasco Ibarra charged that the election was fraudulent and attempted a coup; it failed and its leaders, including Velasco Ibarra and Carlos Guevara Moreno, were exiled. Within a few months of his inauguration Peru invaded territory claimed by Ecuador. In 1944 he was removed from office as a result of the defeat in the 1941 border war with Peru, and Velasco Ibarra was recalled from exile to replace him.

body.zh-Hant: 去職後阿羅約·德爾里奧離開厄瓜多爾，先到哥倫比亞，再到紐約市；1948年他返回瓜亞基爾，重操律師業，直到去世仍是公眾攻擊的對象。他於1969年10月31日去世。
body.en: After his removal Arroyo del Río left the country, going first to Colombia and then to New York City; he returned to Guayaquil in 1948 to resume his legal practice. He remained the target of public attacks until his death, which came on 31 October 1969.

heading.zh-Hant: 交出臨時行政權與1940年大選
heading.en: Handing over interim power and the 1940 election

body.zh-Hant: 陸軍歷史研究中心的專書寫道，阿羅約·德爾里奧當時任參議院議長並接掌政權；被自由黨提名為總統候選人後，他把所行使的職權交給眾議院議長安德烈斯·F·科爾多瓦。1940年1月12日的選舉中，他被宣布獲勝。
body.en: A history published by the Ecuadorian Army's historical studies centre says Arroyo del Río, then president of the Senate, took over power; once the Liberal Party named him its candidate for the presidency he handed his functions to Andrés F. Córdova, president of the Chamber of Deputies. He was proclaimed the winner of the election of 12 January 1940.

body.zh-Hant: 拉雷多·布魯1875年4月23日出生，是獨立戰爭的老兵，後來成為1936至1940年的古巴總統。他曾任拉斯比亞斯省省長，並在總統何塞·米格爾·戈麥斯手下擔任內政部長。
body.en: Laredo Bru was born on 23 April 1875 and was a veteran of the war of independence who later became president of Cuba from 1936 to 1940. He served as governor of Las Villas Province and as secretary of the interior under President José Miguel Gómez.

heading.en: The 1923 uprising and election as vice president

body.zh-Hant: 1923年他領導不滿的退伍軍人起事，反對總統阿爾弗雷多·薩亞斯。1936年1月他當選古巴副總統；其後總統米格爾·馬里亞諾·戈麥斯遭聽命於陸軍首長富爾亨西奧·巴蒂斯塔的參議院彈劾，他被安排為新的傀儡總統。
body.en: In 1923 he led an uprising of disgruntled veterans against President Alfredo Zayas. He was elected vice president of Cuba in January 1936, and when President Miguel Mariano Gómez was impeached by a Senate subservient to army chief Fulgencio Batista, he was installed as the new figurehead president.

body.zh-Hant: 拉雷多·布魯任古巴總統的時期是1936至1940年。他以從容而有尊嚴的方式履行職責，盡可能抵銷軍方的干預。任內通過全面重整糖業的法律，是該時期最重要的立法之一；1940年憲法也在他任內由自由選出的制憲議會制定。
body.en: Laredo Bru was president of Cuba from 1936 to 1940. He discharged the duties of his office with great aplomb and dignity, counterbalancing military interference as much as possible. A law completely restructuring the sugar industry, one of the most important pieces of legislation of the period, was passed during his term, and the 1940 constitution was framed under him by a freely elected constituent assembly.

body.zh-Hant: 薩拉曼卡1868年7月8日出生，是科恰班巴富有的地主，三十年間擔任口才出眾的國會眾議員與參議員。他在何塞·曼努埃爾·潘多（1899至1904年）的內閣中擔任財政部長。
body.en: Salamanca was born on 8 July 1868. A wealthy Cochabamba landowner, he was for thirty years an eloquent congressional deputy and senator, and he served as secretary of treasury in the cabinet of President José Manuel Pando (1899-1904).

heading.en: Break with the Liberal Party and the Republican Party

body.zh-Hant: 1914年薩拉曼卡與保守的自由黨決裂，協助創建共和黨，1921年又脫離該黨，另組真正共和黨。
body.en: In 1914 Salamanca broke with the conservative Liberal Party and helped found the Republican Party, only to break away again in 1921 to form the Genuine Republican Party.

body.zh-Hant: 薩拉曼卡因強烈的民族主義，以及在政治腐敗的年代堅守清廉，被譽為「新彌賽亞」與「象徵人物」，1931年3月成為體制內眾望所歸的總統人選。然而他的經濟緊縮、對反對派（尤其是左派與共產黨人）的政治鎮壓，以及失敗的查科政策，使他很快成為玻利維亞最不受歡迎的總統之一。1934年11月他在維亞蒙特斯視察查科司令部時，被軍方扣押並推翻。
body.en: Hailed as the "new messiah" and hombre símbolo for his fierce nationalism and scrupulous integrity in an era of political corruption, Salamanca was the establishment's popular choice for president in March 1931. His economic austerity, political repression of the opposition (particularly leftists and Communists), and failed Chaco policy soon left him one of the most unpopular of Bolivian presidents. In November 1934, while he was visiting the Chaco command in Villa Montes, the military seized and deposed him.

heading.zh-Hant: 查科戰爭的評價與去世

body.zh-Hant: 薩拉曼卡被指責要為玻利維亞在查科戰爭（1932至1935年）中敗給巴拉圭負責，也許是二十世紀玻利維亞歷史上最具爭議的人物。他於1935年7月17日去世。
body.en: Salamanca was blamed for Bolivia's defeat by Paraguay in the Chaco War (1932-1935) and may be the most controversial figure of twentieth-century Bolivian history. He died on 17 July 1935.

heading.zh-Hant: 與軍方的歧見與被推翻
heading.en: Disputes with the military and overthrow

body.zh-Hant: 查科戰爭於1932年6月因玻、巴兩國哨所衝突而起。戰事進行中，總統薩拉曼卡與軍方領導人在戰略與優先事項上的歧見日深，他曾下令軍隊暫停行動。1934年11月27日，他被推翻。
body.en: The Chaco War began in June 1932 when Bolivian and Paraguayan outposts clashed. As the war went on, President Salamanca and the military leaders grew more at odds over strategy and priorities, and he ordered the army to suspend operations. He was overthrown on 27 November 1934.
